tools.name: swatch_check_contrast
tools.description: Use when the user asks whether a color combination is readable or accessible, passes WCAG AA or AAA, or has enough contrast (text on a background, button, badge, link color). Returns the exact contrast ratio, pass or fail for normal text, large text and UI components at AA and AAA, the APCA lightnes

tools.name: swatch_fix_contrast
tools.description: Use when a color pair fails contrast and the user wants the smallest change that makes it pass, such as "make this gray text accessible without changing the look". Returns the closest text color on that background that reaches the target (AA, AAA, AA-large or ui), and separately the closest backgrou

tools.name: swatch_pick_text_color
tools.description: Use when the user asks what text color (black or white) to put on a given background, button or brand color so it is readable. Returns the better of black or white with both contrast ratios, the WCAG grade and a softer near-black option. Example: {"background": "#ff5a1f"}.

tools.name: swatch_make_scale
tools.description: Use when the user asks for a palette, shades, tints, a design-token scale or a Tailwind-style 50 to 950 ramp from a brand color. Returns 11 steps that keep the hue, with the hex, contrast on white and on black, and the best text color for each step. Example: {"color": "#ff5a1f", "name": "brand"}.

tools.name: swatch_convert_color
tools.description: Use when the user asks to convert a color between hex, RGB, HSL and OKLCH, or asks what a color is called or how light it is. Returns all formats, the relative luminance and the nearest CSS color name. Example: {"color": "#ff5a1f"}. Exact math, so prefer it to converting by hand.

tools.name: swatch_check_pairs
tools.description: Use when the user has a whole design system, theme or stylesheet and wants every text and background pair checked for accessibility in one go.
